scope: Host-only fusion of private operator inputs with one current-pixel source instruction. Explicit query-clock instructions preserve source seconds/progress and invalid-query black. Shared compiler cleanup compacts removed loop states. Graph assembly omits replaced nodes and their bindings/workspaces. Current wire format 44; no retained sampled-frame cache.
method: ESP32 rev3.1, 240 MHz, one core, Wi-Fi off, GPIO untouched. Cargo release opt-level 3, fat LTO, one codegen unit. Old and fused archives run in the same diagnostic image, with counting disabled. Each case evaluates 32 frames including first use. Two-second controls bracket 997/1999 us PC sampling. Evaluation/output encoding only; excludes network, storage, DMA and physical output. No laptop timing comparison.

correctness.focused_coverage: Six runtime fusion tests cover native clock quantization, invalid queries, large durations, partial blocks, seeks, branches, early returns, multiple input/parameter banks, arrays/resources, caller automation, source-automation boundaries, ordered source failures and removal of unreachable loop storage. Elaboration coverage compares shared and separately fusible graph branches.
correctness.rounding: Small FP changes are permitted; this phase introduces no reference-frame changes.

validation: cargo fmt and full pnpm check pass, including frontend checks, 135 runtime unit tests, project save/load and graph tests, exhaustive schema validation (586.86 seconds), 16 firmware-owned host storage tests and all-target/all-feature Clippy with warnings denied. Final formatted sources reproduce all measured archives and match the checkout. The complete controller release builds and links.

hotspot_percent.note: Weighted self-symbol shares from both sampling periods. The shared interpreter includes inlined math/register/control-flow work and cannot distinguish effect/operator callers. A larger percentage after optimization does not itself mean a larger absolute cost.

findings: Stanford improves 5.5 percent and releases 1072 retained bytes. Mixed fusion changes mean time by only 0.14 percent and releases 552 retained bytes; no substantial mixed speedup or cache-hit gain is claimed. Other same-image changes are negligible. Cross-image mixed timing falls from the staged/block baseline's 291705 to 106703 us, approximately 2.73x, and still misses the 16.667 ms evaluation budget on every measured frame. The mixed echo still evaluates four source effects three times per output pixel.
regression_investigation: Inlining a constant source exposed unreachable-loop metadata surviving instruction removal. Fixed loop-state compaction in the shared compiler/specializer, with a reproducing test. Fusion declines transformations that would lose existing block execution or duplicate source code; source automation and shared graph consumers retain their boundaries.
raw_evidence: Ignored target/vm-opt-20261002/program-fusion contains paired archives, capture, PC attribution, regenerated archives, image/build/check logs and source hashes. Focused host logs are in the sibling numeric-blocks directory. Only this reviewed summary is retained outside target.
